players.bio: Commanding goalkeeper with strong presence in penalty situations.
players.coachNotes: Keep distribution quick when opponents press high.

players.bio: Energetic right back who overlaps aggressively.
players.coachNotes: Time the underlap when Messi drifts inside.

players.name: Cristian Romero
players.bio: Front-foot center back with strong duel success.
players.coachNotes: Avoid early card risk in first 20 minutes.

players.name: Nicolas Otamendi
players.bio: Veteran organizer who leads the defensive line.
players.coachNotes: Pair with a faster cover defender against transition teams.

players.name: Nicolas Tagliafico
players.bio: Reliable left back with balanced defending and support play.
players.coachNotes: Can invert when Mac Allister drops into build-up.

players.name: Rodrigo De Paul
players.bio: High-energy midfielder who connects midfield and attack.
players.coachNotes: Primary counter-press trigger on right side.

players.name: Enzo Fernandez
players.bio: Progressive midfielder with strong passing range.
players.coachNotes: Anchor rest-defense shape when fullbacks advance.

players.name: Alexis Mac Allister
players.bio: Composed midfielder who controls tight central spaces.
players.coachNotes: Best used as left-sided connector in 4-3-3.

players.name: Angel Di Maria

players.coachNotes: Use as impact starter or early second-half matchup lever.

players.coachNotes: Build right-sided rotations around his receiving lane.

players.coachNotes: Best first press when center backs split wide.

players.coachNotes: Strong option when changing to two forwards.

players.coachNotes: Manage minutes; ideal against compact blocks.

players.coachNotes: Use when protecting a lead and slowing tempo.

players.coachNotes: Useful when rotating Mac Allister's minutes.

players.coachNotes: Monitor card risk when defending quick wingers.

players.coachNotes: Target him on far-post corners if chasing a goal.

players.coachNotes: Can replace Otamendi when needing faster cover.

players.coachNotes: Good closer when protecting central zones.

tactics.customPlaystyle: Right-side overloads through Molina, De Paul, and Messi, with Mac Allister connecting the left half-space.
tactics.customDefensiveStyle: Mid-block that jumps on backwards passes; protect central lane first.
tactics.customStrategyNotes: Use Lautaro as first press. If leading after 70 minutes, add Paredes and shift to a more compact midfield triangle.

notes.title: Brazil Game Right Overload
notes.content: Start attacks through the right triangle, then switch quickly to Alvarez when the far-side fullback narrows.

notes.title: Set Piece Priority
notes.content: Di Maria takes inswinging corners from the right; Messi takes direct free kicks and penalties.

notes.title: Late Lead Shape
notes.content: Introduce Paredes, narrow the midfield, and reduce fullback overlap after minute 70 if leading.
